desc: 年幼时，鹭鸶剪曾经问过她的监护人，自己的生日为什么是八月十五日？老人捋着胡须微微一笑，告诉她，这是师门上下合力算出来的——那年八月最好的日子。尽管在后来的日子里，流行的历法变化甚多，但她仍旧保留了这组数字作为自己的生日。|在遥远的过去，鹭鸶剪的生日常与赏月团圆的日子一同庆祝。当芭妮芭妮端上印着“生日快乐”字样的月饼时，她带着怀念的心情赞许了第一助手的巧思。|欢宴散去的时候，鹭鸶剪站在人群之外，观察着这些不同于既往的过客。她忽然意识到，这次，她或许可以置身其中。|为了同步观赏这天出现的超级月亮奇观，鹭鸶剪今年的生日在郊外高山上庆祝，并最终演变成了一场与月亮有关的故事会。|当众人为因魔精的意外入侵而变得乱七八糟的生日布置一筹莫展时，鹭鸶剪笑着用各色剪纸花样重新装点了现场，其中“骡子食月饼”的限定图纸得到了一致好评。
useDesc: 承载了珍贵记忆的彩色相片，可用于邀请此神秘学家。
desc2: 不昧因果的道门传人，远东杂学术法的收集者，你最洒脱任真的朋友之一。

character_data.text:
神秘学家艺术品，展出于14世纪末、16世纪末、17世纪初及20世纪90年代，参展时长未知，据称诞生于盛夏。曾展出于中国多地，现保藏于圣洛夫基金会。

尺寸：66 17/32×15 3/4×23 5/8in.
介质：天地之气
香调：馥奇调 粉红牡丹 薄荷 苔藓 广藿香
灵感：未折的梅枝[木] 逍遥游

character_data.title: “断长生”
character_data.text: 被折断后失去了神秘学上的不凡之处，却仍被精心保存下来的白玉法剑。曾经代表着一份传承、一脉守护、一门有道之士，以及一条通向不朽的道路。受访者称其现在的主要作用是切割水果和糕点。

character_data.title: “一剪春色”
character_data.text: 通过折叠和剪裁使红纸上呈现精美生动的纹样，在远东的年节，这往往被用来装饰门窗，增添节日氛围。梅花的纹样显然受到创作者的偏爱，这被猜测与她年幼时居所的植被种类有关。

character_data.title: “冷暖自知”
character_data.text: 在旧时代相当常见的瓷碗，质朴耐用，适合用来盛装各种食物和水。受访者有幸保留了一只，并未让其进入古董市场流通，而是用来盛装回忆。

character_data.title: 水银、仙人与金丹
character_data.text:
一位贵客轮番延请炼金术士进入内室交谈：他们擅于熔炼丹砂、水银与黄金，对于鬼魂也有独到见解；另一位贵客向无尽之海派出寻找仙人的浩大船队，希望自己和记载功勋的东方石碑一样万世永存。
死亡宣告了他们的失败。
第三、第四位贵客从前辈们那儿得到教训，加倍小心；第五位故态复萌，下场不妙；第六位假装压根没这么回事，让一切暗中进行。接下来还有第七、第八位在排队……似乎有些荒唐，但——只要可以，为什么不呢？谁愿意放弃一颗完满的金丹？谁不想白日飞升离开凡俗，进入不朽？
“所以……我派众人须勤加修行，不能有一日懈怠？”
“如前所述。”
“长生之法也并不能免去世间的种种繁杂。”
“确然如此。”
“相反，它可能会带来麻烦……世俗的麻烦，以及别的困扰。”
“与日俱增。”
“还有孤独。”
“嗯，还有孤独。”
“我明白了……”
“如此，你是否仍愿意修习我派金丹术，以镇压妖兽为己任？”
短暂的沉默。
“弟子愿意。”
关于长生，在某个角落，也有人轻声作出这样的回答。

character_data.title: 梅花如旧
character_data.titleEn: The Mei Flowers Blossom as Always
character_data.text:
祝县山中有梅，传为白马真人手自植，枝叶亭亭，逾百年矣。乡里呼之长生梅花。
余少时读书涣州，常踏青山中。其间惨绿心事、晨昏忧乐，梅花每多见之。后六十年，余乞骸骨，自京中归。时维暮春，天大晴，油菜初熟，麦芒新发，四下寂寂，闾里唯见一青春道人。余年衰迈，不能拄杖访故山，遂问：“长生梅花尚在否？”答：“梅花如旧。然公来迟，今岁花信过矣。”叹曰：“梅花如旧，唯人零落耳。”因诉前事。
道人似有深思，曰：“我亦久不见长生梅花。遇合乖违，各有缘分。今日既逢，我有一物可以示君。”乃剪纸作梅枝，吹堕土中，顷刻枝条生发，芳菲四散。梅花漫天，余望其鲜妍敷荣，因念旧时颜色，泪下潸然。待敛容欲谢，则余香在手，莫知所踪。
                                         ——《涣州拾遗》卷七 

洒脱的批注：如今它改名叫“城中公园那棵梅花树”了！谁能料到这里会建公园？
一笔一划的批注：只是BBS上惯用的称呼，你不能认为那便是它的名字。
洒脱的批注：好吧！你说得对。不过，它仍然是它。

character_data.title: 行万里路
character_data.text:
白雪松：根据资料，你旅行的目的是弄明白如何找回缺失的五感。
鹭鸶剪：最开始是这样。不过，我发现四处走走本身也很有意思。
白雪松：现在找到答案了吗？
鹭鸶剪：说不定呢。
白雪松：说不定？
鹭鸶剪：大道无形，谁知道我要找的答案长什么样、会出现在哪里？
鹭鸶剪：或许它是一朵花、一片叶子，一位路过的神秘学家，以及她刚刚烤好的点心。
鹭鸶剪：又或许……是一张纸？
白雪松：鹭鸶剪女士，请别盯着我的速记本。我知道你有剪纸的爱好。
鹭鸶剪：哈哈，玩笑而已。请放心，按照远东传统，我们通常不用白色纸张裁剪窗花。
白雪松：好吧，下一个问题：你会考虑乘坐现代交通工具吗？
鹭鸶剪：当然会啦！我是个有好奇心的人。
白雪松：但我们从另一位受访者处得知，你日前曾计划骑着骡子从远东前往南极。
鹭鸶剪：咳咳，他们告诉我带着骡子上飞机需要许多手续……这实在太复杂了。
鹭鸶剪：可我总不能丢下它吧？
鹭鸶剪：问题不大，反正我们也不赶时间，对不对？

character_voice.name: 初遇
character_voice.content: 刚才那纺车转得也太快了些……#0|咦，你这身打扮瞧着很是新鲜，想来世间又换了年岁。#3.02|小道鹭鸶剪，还望日后多多关照了。#9.69
character_voice.encontent: Oooof, that was quite a spin ...#0|Well now, would you look at you? Time truly does gallop like a wild horse, eh?#3.5|I am Paper Heron, humble Daoist, wanderer—and very glad to make your acquaintance.#8.6

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: 哎呀，下雨了……#0|涣州的雨与此地不同，是沾衣欲湿的杏花雨。#1.7|这样的天气里，哪怕走过整条长街，也不过在鬓边添上几颗小水珠而已。#5.39
character_voice.encontent: Oh! Rain ... Quite unlike the kind in Huanzhou.#0|"A drizzle through spring blossoms holds no wet, just as a gentle breeze beneath willows carries no cold," they'd say.#5.3|You could walk in it all day and come away with only a few pearly drops in your hair.#13.7

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 有一回，我在南方遇到一位立志要朝北海而暮苍梧的同乡，劝我多记些见闻。#0|那时我无甚所感，现在想来，写一卷笔记也不错——#6.03|或许是很多很多卷？这里有趣的事可太多了！#10.14
character_voice.encontent: Once, a countryman with ambitions to measure the land with his own feet urged me to put my journey into words.#0|I didn't think much of it then, but lately, it feels worth a volume or two. Or ten.#7.4|What can I say? Haha—there's so much worth remembering these days!#13.8

character_voice.name: 孑立
character_voice.content: 怎么闷着不说话，莫不是有什么难处？来来，我给你掷一卦，#0|正面是顺风顺水，反面嘛，是有惊无险。#4.87
character_voice.encontent: Why the sullen look, hm? Something weighing on you? Come—sit. Let's see what this coin has to say.#0|Heads, and all will be well. Tails ... and, well, let's just say you're in for a lucky escape.#8.48

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: 啊，是你呀！我还没能完全习惯这种生活——拥有固定的栖居之所，开门迎接造访的朋友。#0|好在来日方长。#7.33
character_voice.encontent: Ah! Oh, it's you! I'm still settling in. Not so used to staying in one place, see—especially with so many visitors.#0|Lucky for me, I have a few more centuries to get accustomed to it.#8.4

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: 我们修道之人讲究顺其自然，所谓顺其自然，便是行随意动，#0|困了就睡个回笼觉，等饿了再起来吃饭……所以，今早吃什么？#5.38
character_voice.encontent: To follow the Way is to master the art of flow—unbound and ever at ease: #0|if you're tired, nap; if you're hungry, eat ... Speaking of which, what's for breakfast?#7.46

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: 这是一个沉静的清晨，这里有……风，让人心情舒畅明快的风……我感受到了！#0|它……柔和，而且清凉，对不对？#10.8
character_voice.encontent: A quiet morning indeed. Wait, this touch on my cheek, is it ... the morning breeze?#0|So soft, so crisp ... You feel it too, don't you?#10.7

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 我喜欢爬上最高的屋顶，眺望远处忽明忽暗的灯火，偶尔还能听到隐隐约约的熙攘人声。#0|那时我觉得离这一切似乎很近，又似乎很远。#7.23
character_voice.encontent: I often climb the highest roof I can find—watch the city lights flicker below, listen to the laughter riding on the wind.#0|It all feels so familiar, and yet somehow so very far away.#10.3

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 那天有轮好月亮，照得前路一片明亮，几乎有些不真切。#0|我走过百年前修缮的石阶，以及新抽芽的茅草……#5.5|那棵梅花树在山顶远远望着我。#10.97|如今看来，也是很久之前的事了。#15.7
character_voice.encontent: It was a bright, silvery night—the sort where the moon bathes the world in a thin sheen.#0|For the first time in a hundred years, I climbed those stairs again, through grass that had surely sprung anew countless times.#7.2|And yet, there it was—the Mei tree, looking down at me from atop the mountain.#19.1|Hard to believe another few hundred years have passed since even that night.#29

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: 你喜欢这簪子上的梅花？#0|唔，梅花可不是什么好相与的，#2.15|说是傲霜斗雪，其实逾北不生、逢春不开，#5.16|最有脾气不过。#8.3
character_voice.encontent: The flower on my hairpin—ah, the Mei blossom? You like it, eh?#0|It certainly isn't the easiest flower to favor.#6.1|Admired for blooming in frost and snow, yet cannot bear even the smallest touch of warmth.#9.6|Quite the temperament, I'd say.#16.2

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: ——仍是一把好剑。#0
character_voice.encontent: —Still does all a sword must do.#0

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 撒豆成兵、挥剑成河，这等小事自然不在话下！#0|怎么，难道水沟就不算河了吗？剪纸小人当然也是兵啦！#3.87
character_voice.encontent: Scattered beans turned into an army, a river carved with the stroke of a sword—all child's play to me!#0|Just a ditch and paper-cut figures? Come now—large or small, life or death, everything is relative.#8.07

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 湖边水草丰美，倒适合种花……#0|唔，我从前一直想试试，可惜很少在一处地方久留。#3.07|比起别的，花草是最公平不过的，#7.68|就算侍弄的人有十二万分的天才，倘若只有三分用心，那也只得三分结果。#10.22
character_voice.encontent: The lakeside soil is rich—a fine place to grow flowers.#0|I've often thought to try my hand at gardening, but I never stayed in one place long enough.#5.8|Flowers speak of their keeper, don't you think?#12.9|Even the most talented gardener won't reap much if they tend them without care.#16.8

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: 已知天地之广，却仍关心一草一木的生机。#0|若修道之人都如你这般就好了。#4.57
character_voice.encontent: Carrying the vastness of heaven and earth in your mind, while holding the lives of the small in your heart.#0|If all who practiced Daoism were as steadfast as you, the world would be a kinder place.#7.3

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: 你看，这里有张刚剪的窗花……不，不是符箓，也不是新的术法——#0|一只小燕子，蛮灵的呀，是不是？#5.45
character_voice.encontent: Here, a paper cutting I made just now ... No, not a talisman—not a magic trick either. It's the real thing!#0|A sparrow, see? Adorable, eh?#8.68

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: 你看，这里有张刚剪的窗花……不，不是符箓，也不是新的术法——#0|一只小燕子，蛮灵的呀，是不是？#5.45
character_voice.encontent: Here, a paper cutting I made just now ... No, not a talisman—not a magic trick either. It's the real thing!#0|A sparrow, see? Adorable, eh?#8.68

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 我晓得如今不时兴骑骡子了，可还是想和它一道出门。#0|不是它驮着我，是我带着它，带着一位老朋友。#4.14
character_voice.encontent: I know people travel by other means these days, but I still prefer to hop on my mule.#0|After all, traveling is best done with a loyal friend by your side, eh?#5.68

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 那位人首鸟身的前辈——莫不是传说中的灭蒙鸟？#0|真奇妙，我见过许多人穷尽所有追逐长生，他们却以一生去寻觅值得舍弃悠长寿数的理由……#4.91|说到底，长生与否，不过是为了某个执念罢了。#15.4
character_voice.encontent: That human-faced bird ... Is he a Miemeng?#0|A curious race—given lifetimes upon lifetimes, yet ever searching for a cause worth dying for.#5.2|I suppose, in the end, whether our lives are long or short, we all pursue our own meaning.#13.7

character_voice.name: 独白
character_voice.content: 有人告诉过我，花因注视才变得明艳；世上除了我们的心，原就什么也没有……#0|待我看遍千千万万的花，不知是否能找回从前观花的心境。#7.4
character_voice.encontent: I was once told that a flower—its color, scent, its shape as we see it—exists only within our consciousness.#0|I wonder, after a thousand miles, if my world will be the same as when I first set out.#11.6

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: 小道乐意效劳。#0
character_voice.encontent: Your humble Daoist, at your service.#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: 好！今日便由我来！#0
character_voice.encontent: Very well! Let me try my hand!#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 这一式倒有些意思。#0
character_voice.encontent: Ah, an interesting one.#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 嗯，让我算算……#0
character_voice.encontent: Hmm, let me think on it ...#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语
character_voice.content: 天行有常。#0
character_voice.encontent: The workings of heaven remain constant.#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 道存于斯。#0
character_voice.encontent: Such is the Way.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.encontent: Rise!#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.encontent: Ah, what a bloom!#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 存元。#0
character_voice.encontent: Concentrate and visualize.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 这便成了！#0
character_voice.encontent: And that's that!#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 天地悉皆归。#0
character_voice.encontent: Heaven and earth are one within me.#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 哎呀呀……#0
character_voice.encontent: Whoa, easy now ...#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 好本事！#0
character_voice.encontent: I'm impressed!#0

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content: 喏，是不是灵的？#0
character_voice.encontent: Not bad, eh?#0

character_voice.name: 洞悉
character_voice.content: 终不再是隔帘望月、雾中观花……#0|世间的诸般声色，原就与我相连。#3.02
character_voice.encontent: At last, the veil that once distanced me from the world has lifted.#0|Its sights, its sounds, its tastes ... I feel them all again.#5.36

character_voice.name: 洞悉
character_voice.content: 终不再是隔帘望月、雾中观花……#0|世间的诸般声色，原就与我相连。#3.02
character_voice.encontent: At last, the veil that once distanced me from the world has lifted.#0|Its sights, its sounds, its tastes ... I feel them all again.#5.36

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: “此身天地一虚舟，何处江山不自由。”#0
character_voice.encontent: "Be as a humble boat drifting on the world's boundless waters; so shall one find freedom in every land."#0

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: “此身天地一虚舟，何处江山不自由。”#0
character_voice.encontent: "Be as a humble boat drifting on the world's boundless waters; so shall one find freedom in every land."#0

character_voice.name: 入场
character_voice.content: 世上已有太多受人欢迎的长生故事，常分两种：#0|或是仙家眷恋红尘，或是凡客欣羡玉京。#3.74|不过，我仍要再添上新的一个——在此二者之间。#7.27
character_voice.encontent: There are two kinds of tales on longevity:#0|one where an immortal is drawn to the world below, and one where a mortal longs for the world above.#3.1|But I would suggest a third: a tale of one who walks between the two.#9.88

character_voice.name: 主页交互触发
character_voice.content: “望气”并不仅是术法，更是外物与己身偕一的修行，#0|譬如……咳咳，这位道友，借问梅花何处落？#4.36
character_voice.encontent: Mastering Qi is not merely a matter of learning a few techniques; it is a cultivation of both body and mind.#0|Now, let's see—ahem. "Whence does the Mei flutter and fall?"#8.2

character_voice.name: 左手成功
character_voice.content: 你确定？……对了！风吹一夜——满关山！#0|梅花新雪、鱼龙灯火，如何，喜欢吗？#4.49
character_voice.encontent: Are you sure? ... Correct! "Across the far frontiers, it whitens the wilds."#0|Look—Mei blossoms, lanterns ... How about them, eh?#8.29

character_voice.name: 右手成功
character_voice.content: 你确定？……对了！风吹一夜——满关山！#0|梅花新雪、鱼龙灯火，如何，喜欢吗？#4.49
character_voice.encontent: Are you sure? ... Correct! "Across the far frontiers, it whitens the wilds."#0|Look—Mei blossoms, lanterns ... How about them, eh?#8.29

character_voice.name: 左手失败
character_voice.content: 你确定？……唔，看来它仍在你的心外啊。#0
character_voice.encontent: Are you sure? ... Haha—perhaps next time look within, hm?#0

character_voice.name: 右手失败
character_voice.content: 你确定？……唔，看来它仍在你的心外啊。#0
character_voice.encontent: Are you sure? ... Haha—perhaps next time look within, hm?#0

character_voice.name: 未交互
character_voice.content: 唔，梅花谢了——不过没关系，下回我剪一朵新的，到时候你再试试。就这么说好了？#0
character_voice.encontent: Ah, there it goes. Now, now, don't look like that; I'll make you another next time. Deal?#0

skin.name: 鹭鸶剪
skin.skinDescription: 光阴荏苒之后，她还认得自己。

skin.name: 鹭鸶剪
skin.skinDescription: 万家灯火，鱼龙漫天，而她亦有小舟一叶。

1341011.content: 喏，你也尝尝。这是梁小姐带来的灌汤包，可好吃了。
今天是我的生辰，她多给了我几个。
哎，庄周梦蝶，蝶梦庄周。生日是个令人高兴的彩头。
我望气而知，今天是个八风和顺的好日子，宜出行，宜庆礼。
在今日庆祝生日又何妨？
谢啦！八月十五，可是个团圆的好日子。
往年这个时间，门中会张灯结彩，漂亮极了。我做小寿星的时候，也能得着不少稀奇的礼物。
此时此地，风和景明，流水潺潺，亦是佳处。
道友可否帮我折几只红梅？从前师姐最爱赠我此物。

1341012.content: 道友留步。小道见你日日工作，劳心劳力，也该稍加犒劳自己。
可有什么想吃的，想玩的？或是想看什么新术法？
小道乐意效劳——这次可不需铜板。
哎呀呀，是不是在屋子里闷太久了？
我在树中的那些年岁，独自一人，身处黑暗，心中亦是无所感、无所想。
不过尝遍八味，游遍四方，感受七情之后——我这五感，也渐渐回来了。
道友若无事，可多与我出去走走。外面的气清凉柔和，最是怡人。
答应得这么干脆？道友不会是在敷衍我吧？
放心，倒也不是要你早睡早起——这我自己都做不来，嘿嘿。
只是如果觉得累了，不妨顺其自然，停下来歇歇。
毕竟，未来的日子还很长呢。
